subject: Intro + MAP: Aligning goals & proposed 6-week eval window
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + MAP: Aligning goals & proposed 6-week eval window

Hi Liam and Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. As promised, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align goals, owners, and a proposed 6-week evaluation window so we can get a pilot running quickly.

At a high level I propose:
- Objective: Validate Redwood Inference performance/cost for HealthLytics data-processing pipelines and the accuracy profile on your 1M token test set.
- Success criteria: sub-100ms p95 serving latency for 2k prompt/hr baseline; <10% regression in key accuracy benchmarks vs current baseline.
- Timeline: 6-week pilot (deploy week 1 -> validation + tuning weeks 2–5 -> decision/next-steps week 6).
- Owners: Liam (Champion) — product/requirements & acceptance; Priya (Engineering) — infra + test harness; Irene (AE) — MAP coordination & commercial; Marissa (CSM) — post-pilot success plan; Karthik (SE) — integration and benchmark support.

I attached a short MAP template and a 50-day outline to make this concrete. Can you please:
1) Confirm the goals above are aligned with the team's expectations,
2) Confirm owners and whether the proposed 6-week window works for HealthLytics,
3) Share any calendar constraints for an initial 30-minute kickoff this week or early next week.

If that all sounds good, I’ll circulate the MAP doc and an initial agenda for the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HealthLytics_MAP_Template_v1.pdf (PDF, 220KB); 50-day-eval-outline.xlsx (Spreadsheet, 48KB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@healthlytics.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@healthlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP: Aligning goals & proposed 6-week eval window

On Mon, Jun 15, 2026 at 9:12 AM Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks again for the time last week. As promised, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align goals...

Thanks Irene — this looks great and very actionable. Quick confirmations from our side:
- Goals: aligned. The latency target is reasonable, and we care about the accuracy check across our 5 exemplar models.
- Owners: confirmed — I’ll act as the champion. Priya will lead infra, and I’ll loop in our data platform lead (cc’ing Priya here).
- Timeline: the 6-week window is acceptable, though we have a dependency: a sanitized subset of the 1M token test set will be ready by June 25th. If we start the pilot the week of June 29th that fits better.

Kickoff: I’m available Thursday (Jun 18) 10–11am PT or Friday (Jun 19) 2–4pm PT for a 30-minute sync. Priya, does either work for you?

Also, if Marissa or Karthik need access to any internal tracking systems, we can open a temporary service account for benchmark runs.

Thanks — excited to get going.

—Liam
Head of Product, HealthLytics
liam.oconnor@healthlytics.com | +1 (617) 555-3321

[Quoted attachments: HealthLytics onboarding notes (see attached MAP template)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intro + MAP: Aligning goals & proposed 6-week eval window — quick internal note

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Liam’s reply. Key points:
- Start week: target week of June 29th (sanitized test data available Jun 25).
- Kickoff: Liam proposed Thu 6/18 10–11am PT or Fri 6/19 2–4pm PT — we should pick one and lock it.
- Owners: Liam (champion), Priya (HealthLytics infra), Karthik (SE lead for benchmarks), Marissa (post-pilot success).

Action items for us:
- Karthik: prepare a short integration checklist + access guide for HealthLytics service account; I'll share our baseline benchmark script and expected data shape by EOD Thu.
- Marissa: prepare a 6-week success checklist we can share at kickoff (customer outcomes, decision criteria, and post-pilot next steps).
- Irene: I’ll update the MAP template with confirmed owners and proposed dates, then send the calendar invite once Liam confirms the kickoff slot.

Thanks — quick and focused. I’ll wait to lock the kickoff until Liam confirms the slot with Priya.

Best,
Irene
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
